title: Warm, solid surface hierarchy
original: Light mode mixed translucent cream surfaces, tinted nested modules and ornamental canvas gradients.
implemented: Warm #f5f3e9 canvas, #faf9f3 cards, #fffdf8 raised/field surfaces, #eeefe5 inset areas, and light-only shared card/navigation shadow/border refinement. Same anatomy, fonts and density.

title: Recognizable editable controls
original: Light field boundaries measured 1.71:1 against the field; pale borders were indistinguishable from decorative dividers.
implemented: Shared editable controls now use emphasized #7b8878 borders, distinct field surface, explicit placeholder tone and muted read-only/disabled surfaces.

measurement.after: 3.67:1 field boundary; light focus 5.00:1 against field
measurement.method: Actual computed opaque field colors in foundations.before/after.json; no inactive-control contrast requirement asserted.

title: Readable small metadata
original: Small metadata on tinted care cards and public exhibits measured below 4.5:1 (examples 4.44 and 4.33).
implemented: Route legacy light metadata through shared #606b61 muted and #465348 secondary roles, preserving type sizes.
darkImpact: Mappings are light-only; intentionally light public surfaces remain light.

measurement.after: Muted role 5.28:1 on the main card; actual route samples recorded in measurements.json
measurement.method: Computed ancestor-composited route samples. Uncertainty retained for gradients/opacity; not a full WCAG certification.

title: Charts consume theme roles
original: Metric charts forced a dark surface in light mode; the white warning symbol on amber lacked normal-text contrast.
implemented: Theme-aware chart surface, labels, series, grid, tooltip and marker pairs; identical plot geometry, data and clustering.
darkImpact: Dark chart foundation/series/tooltip values retained. Amber and resolved symbols deliberately use dark text to correct contrast.

measurement.after: Light warning symbol white on #80601e 5.82:1; dark symbols checked ≥4.5:1
measurement.method: Opaque SVG fill pairs, separately validated by check:theme-harmonization; DOM color scans alone do not measure SVG fills.

title: Calm lineage surfaces and labels
original: Layered gradients and fixed label colors bypassed theme roles.
implemented: Light graph uses recessed canvas, raised readable nodes and quieter shadows. Label fills/text/borders consume shared roles; edge colors, widths, dash patterns, layout and relationships retained.
darkImpact: Dark graph label role values match the previous fixed colors.

title: Readiness belongs to the surface hierarchy
original: Readiness used a separate translucent yellow-beige panel.
implemented: Light readiness panels use the shared inset surface/divider roles. Completeness values, labels and progress geometry remain unchanged.
darkImpact: Dark styling unchanged; confidence/completeness meaning not conflated.

title: Readable botanical support action
original: The normal-size white Ko-fi action label on terracotta measured 3.34:1.
implemented: Preserve the terracotta brand fill and use dark heading text; hover remains readable.
darkImpact: Marketing continues to force light mode.

measurement.after: 4.92:1 normal label; hover pair separately checked
measurement.method: Opaque foreground/background calculation and actual route scan.

title: Opacity does not hide actionable labels
original: Whole-card archival opacity and unselected filter opacity dimmed text as well as decorative surfaces. Ancestor opacity is a separate compositing risk.
implemented: Keep activity card/filter text fully opaque in light mode. Existing selection ring and aria-pressed states retain selection cues; archival labels and image grayscale retained.
darkImpact: Light-only override; accepted dark dimming unchanged.

measurement.before: Group-opacity candidate, not assigned an exact baseline ratio
measurement.after: Full text opacity; computed metadata roles meet threshold on the rendered surfaces
measurement.method: Visible light-state opacity assertions, plus sampled text checks. No fabricated gradient ratio.
